Clarifying product and packaging specifications

A guide to preparing your inquiry with MAI KỲ HÀ SEAFOOD.

IN THIS GUIDE

  1. Product form
  2. Size and units
  3. Packaging
  4. Confirm before ordering

Product form

Specify whole or processed form and your detailed requirements. The product name alone does not define the full specifications.

Size and units

State size, weight and quantity units clearly to avoid misunderstandings.

Packaging

Discuss pack weight, packing method, labels and the information to be displayed.

Confirm before ordering

Compare the quotation with your original requirements before confirming the order.

PUT THIS INTO PRACTICE

Specify your units clearly

Distinguish size in grams per fish, pieces per kilogram or another grading system; quantity in kilograms or tonnes; and packaging in kilograms per carton. If net and gross weights are required, state them separately.

The example units help describe your requirements; they are not standard supply specifications offered by MAI KỲ HÀ SEAFOOD.
